rows: Ring-gas ma ho, ton-ding-ku, ma-mu-ji De-ba-tan-ta i;
Ai di-par-mu-du-mu-du Ho, u-nang ha-lu-pa-hon i.
Di-se-sa do do-sa-mu, Di dao-ni sa-hit-mi, Di-u-dut do ho-sa-mu, Di bu-ri ton-di-mi. Hu-hut di-a-pul-a-pul Ro-ham, na mar-sak i; A-sa tung lam hu-mi-bul mi-ngot u-hum-na i.

verses: Ringgas ma ho, tondingku, mamuji Debatanta i;
Ai diparmudu-mudu Ho, unang halupahon i.
Disesa do dosamu, Di daoni sahitmi,
Diudut do hosamu, Di buri tondimi.
Huhut diapul-apul Roham, na marsak i;
Asa tung lam humibul mingot uhumna i.
Na tolhas do tu hita uhumNa na sumurung i,
Dibaen holong rohaNa diangka na porsea i;
Ai ndada dilaluhon tu hita rimas i;
Sai lam dipatuduhon denggan basaNa i; Ai songon hasundutan,
Dao sian purba i, holang dibaen Ibana sude dosanta i.
Asi roha ni ama marnida anakhonna i,
Suman tusi Jahowa marnida na porsea i,
Diboto do mulanta na sian tano i
Tudoshon bunga bunga, tudoshon bulung i, disi ro habahaba.
Mamintor habang be, suman tusi do jolma, sai mate do sude.
Tung asi ni rohaNa sambing do na manongtong i
Saleleng ni lelengna di tonga huriaNa i,
Di surgo habangsaNa, hinaliangan ni sude parhaladoNa,
Na sun badia i na sai tongtong mamuji, pasangap Tuhan i.
Ho pe tondingku, puji tongtong goarNa i!

r: Na tol-has do tu hi-ta u-hum-Na na su-mu-rung i,
Di-baen ho-long ro-ha-Na di-ang-ka na por-se-a i;
Ai nda-da di-la-lu-hon tu hi-ta ri-mas i; Sai lam di-pa-tu-du-hon deng-gan ba-sa-Na i; Ai so-ngon ha-sun-du-tan, Dao si-an pur-ba i, ho-lang di-baen I-ba-na su-de do-san-ta i.
A-si ro-ha ni a-ma mar-ni-da a-na-khon-na i,
Su-man tu-si Ja-ho-wa mar-ni-da na por-se-a i,
Di-bo-to do mu-lan-ta na si-an ta-no i Tu-dos-hon bu-nga bu-nga, tu-dos-hon bu-lung i, di-si ro ha-ba-ha-ba. Ma-min-tor ha-bang be, su-man tu-si do jol-ma, sai ma-te do su-de.
Tung a-si ni ro-ha-Na sam-bing do na ma-nong-tong i
Sa-le-leng ni le-leng-na di to-nga hu-ri-a-Na i,
Di sur-go ha-bang-sa-Na, hi-na-li-a-ngan ni su-de par-ha-la-do-Na, Na sun ba-di-a i na sai tong-tong ma-mu-ji, pa-sa-ngap Tu-han i. Ho pe ton-ding-ku, pu-ji tong-tong go-ar-Na i!

rows: Naeng pu-ji-on-ku Ho, Ja-ho-wa, ai Ho do De-ba-ta na tu-tu i!
Sai su-ru Ton-di Par-ba-di-a tu au, a-sa hu-pu-ji go-ar-Mi.
Mar-hi-te-hi-te Je-sus, A-nak-Mi, a-sa lo-mo ro-haM di en-deng-ki.

verses: Naeng pujionku Ho, Jahowa, ai Ho do Debata na tutu i!
Sai suru Tondi Parbadia tu au, asa hupuji goarMi.
Marhitehite Jesus, AnakMi, asa lomo rohaM di endengki.
Togihon ma au tu anakMu asa tu Ho ditogu au muse.
TondiM pasaorhon tu tondingku manogu au di dalan na ture.
Asa tongtong gok dame rohangki huhut girgir mamuji goarMi.
Asi rohaM, ale Jahowa! Pamalo au mamuji goarMi.
Sai unang asai puas hata, ingkon tutu dipuji rohangki.
Ho, Ama, Anak dohot Tondi i, doshon na jongjong au dijoloMi.

r: To-gi-hon ma au tu a-nak-Mu a-sa tu Ho di-to-gu au mu-se.
Ton-diM pa-saor-hon tu ton-ding-ku ma-no-gu au di da-lan na tu-re.
A-sa tong-tong gok da-me ro-hang-ki hu-hut gir-gir ma-mu-ji go-ar-Mi.
A-si ro-haM, a-le Ja-ho-wa! Pa-ma-lo au ma-mu-ji go-ar-Mi.
Sai u-nang a-sai pu-as ha-ta, ing-kon tu-tu di-pu-ji ro-hang-ki.
Ho, A-ma, A-nak do-hot Ton-di i, do-shon na jong-jong au di-jo-lo-Mi.

rows: Pu-ji Ja-ho-wa, a-le ton-ding-ku, Pu-ji I-ba-na De-ba-ta-mi.
Ta-gan so su-da do-pe bo-hal-hu, Naeng pu-ji-on-ku ba-sa-na i.
Si-tom-pa da-ging, ton-di pe ing-kon di-pu-ji sa-su-de, Ha-le-lu-ya, Ha-le-lu-ya!

verses: Puji Jahowa, ale tondingku, Puji Ibana Debatami.
Tagan so suda dope bohalhu, Naeng pujionku basana i.
Sitompa daging, tondi pe ingkon dipuji sasude,
Haleluya, Haleluya!
Tubu ni jolma do nang na sangap jala na mulak tu tano i,
Tahitahina pe laho do monjap molo dibondut tanoman i.
Ndang jolma hasonanganki, Debata do haposangki.
Haleluya! Haleluya!
Martua halak ni niendingan ni Debatanta Jahowa i,
Angka na hot marhaporseaon di Jesus Kristus Tuhanta i.
Molo Debata donganmu ndang ndong hurang tuamu.
Haleluya! Haleluya!

Hu-hut tong-tong ba-sa di na-sa ti-nom-pa-Na.
Ri-a ma hi-ta be ma-mu-ji De-ba-ta; Ai se-sa do au-aeng do-san-ta i di-baen.

verses: Sai puji Debata dibaen asi rohaNa.
Huhut tongtong basa di nasa tinompaNa.
Ria ma hita be mamuji Debata;
Ai sesa do auaeng dosanta i dibaen.
Disuru Debata anakNa Jesus Kristus,
Jadi mansai arga do hita on ditobus.
Diporsan Jesus i dosanta sasude asa mudarNa i paias hita be,
Dibahen i tama pujion ni rohanta, Tuhanta Debata,
Nang Jesus pe anakNa, nang Pangondian i,
Naung ro tu hita on manggonti Jesus i, Pujion do tongtong.

Ja-di man-sai ar-ga do hi-ta on di-to-bus.
Di-por-san Je-sus i do-san-ta sa-su-de a-sa mu-dar-Na i pa-i-as hi-ta be,
Di-ba-hen i ta-ma pu-ji-on ni ro-han-ta,
Tu-han-ta De-ba-ta, Nang Je-sus pe a-nak-Na,
nang Pa-ngon-di-an i, Naung ro tu hi-ta on mang-gon-ti Je-sus i, Pu-ji-on do tong-tong.

rows: Sai ta-pu-ji ma Ja-ho-wa, De-ba-tan-ta na tu-tu
Ta-pa-tim-bul ma A-man-ta, na bo-nar hu-hut bur-ju.
Bin-san ho-sang-ki di si, Pu-ji-on-ku Tu-han-ki

verses: Sai tapuji ma Jahowa, Debatanta na tutu
Tapatimbul ma Amanta, na bonar huhut burju.
Binsan hosangki di si, Pujionku Tuhanki.
Ndang haposan ni rohanta dongan na di tano on;
Ai jotjot do mubauba tahi ni rohaninon.
Dung i, molo mate i, pesan ma tahina i.
Sai martua manang ise siasahon Debata;
Ai dison pe dohot muse dipasonang Debata.
Ala ni haposi ma holan Tuhan Debata.
Ai Ibana do sitompa langit dohot tano on,
Rodi isi ni sudena, sasude portibi on.
Debata haposan i, ai tongtong rohaNa i.
Ai Ibana pasintongkon uhum tu na pogos i;
Hangoluan ditumpakhon tu na haleonon i;
Nang na hona hilang pe dipalua do sude.
Sai Ibana patonggorhon mata na mapitung i,
Pangapulon pe dihorhon di parroha na tungki;
Sai diparhamaol tutu nasa jolma na burju.
Sai Ibana mangondingi na mabalu i sude.
Sai Ibana mangurupi na tading di lampin pe.
Sogot uhumonNa be na tois roha i sude.
Debatanta do rajanta salelenglelengna i.
Ala ni las ma rohanta, hita na porsea i,
Taendehon Debata, Rap mandok: Haleluya!

r: Ndang ha-po-san ni ro-han-ta do-ngan na di ta-no on;
Ai jot-jot do mu-ba-u-ba ta-hi ni ro-ha-ni-non.
Dung i, mo-lo ma-te i, pe-san ma ta-hi-na i.
Sai mar-tu-a ma-nang i-se si-a-sa-hon De-ba-ta;
Ai di-son pe do-hot mu-se di-pa-so-nang De-ba-ta.
A-la ni ha-po-si ma ho-lan Tu-han De-ba-ta.
Ai I-ba-na do si-tom-pa la-ngit do-hot ta-no on,
Ro-di i-si ni su-de-na, sa-su-de por-ti-bi on.
De-ba-ta ha-po-san i, ai tong-tong ro-ha-Na i.
Ai I-ba-na pa-sin-tong-kon u-hum tu na po-gos i;
Ha-ngo-lu-an di-tum-pa-khon tu na ha-le-o-non i;
Nang na ho-na hi-lang pe di-pa-lu-a do su-de.
Sai I-ba-na pa-tong-gor-hon ma-ta na ma-pi-tung i,
Pa-nga-pu-lon pe di-hor-hon di par-ro-ha na tung-ki;
Sai di-par-ha-maol tu-tu na-sa jol-ma na bur-ju.
Sai I-ba-na ma-ngon-di-ngi na ma-ba-lu i su-de.
Sai I-ba-na ma-ngu-ru-pi na ta-ding di lam-pin pe.
So-got u-hu-mon-Na be na tois ro-ha i su-de.
De-ba-tan-ta do ra-jan-ta sa-le-leng-le-leng-na i.
A-la ni las ma ro-han-ta, hi-ta na por-se-a i,
Ta-en-de-hon De-ba-ta, Rap man-dok: Ha-le-lu-ya!

rows: Pu-ji Ja-ho-wa na sa-ngap hu-hut mar-mu-li-a,
Ha-mu su-de-na par-ro-ha na ring-gas na ri-a;
Mar-pu-ngu be, mar-o-lop-o-lop su-de, ha-mu su-de ma-ni-si-a.

verses: Puji Jahowa na sangap huhut marmulia,
Hamu sudena parroha na ringgas na ria;
Marpungu be, marolop-olop sude, hamu sude manisia.
Puji Jahowa sigomgom sude parluhutan,
Na manogihon ho songon niiring ni tangan dohot hosam
Songon hombar tu roham sai diramoti Ibanu.
Puji Jahowa, naung tipak manompa dagingmu,
Jala na tongtong manumpak hisar pamatangmu;
Jotjot do ro pangurupiNa tu ho, uju na ro hagogotan.
Puji Jahowa situmpak sude ulaonmu;
Ai ditumpakkon tu ho tongtong hanagoluanmu,
Ingot ma i denggan basaNa do i, tomutomuNa sambing do.
Puji Jahowa tondingku, pasangap goarNa!
Dohot sude na marhosa mamuji Ibana.
I do ture baenon ni hita sude. Sai taendehon ma amen!

r: Pu-ji Ja-ho-wa si-gom-gom su-de par-lu-hu-tan,
Na ma-no-gi-hon ho so-ngon ni-i-ring ni ta-ngan
do-hot ho-sam So-ngon hom-bar tu ro-ham sai di-ra-mo-ti I-ba-nu.
Pu-ji Ja-ho-wa, naung ti-pak ma-nom-pa da-ging-mu,
Ja-la na tong-tong ma-num-pak hi-sar pa-ma-tang-mu;
Jot-jot do ro pa-ngu-ru-pi-Na tu ho, u-ju na ro ha-go-go-tan.
Pu-ji Ja-ho-wa si-tum-pak su-de u-la-on-mu;
Ai di-tum-pak-kon tu ho tong-tong ha-na-go-luan-mu,
I-ngot ma i deng-gan ba-sa-Na do i, to-mu-to-mu-Na sam-bing do.
Pu-ji Ja-ho-wa ton-ding-ku, pa-sa-ngap go-ar-Na!
Do-hot su-de na mar-ho-sa ma-mu-ji I-ba-na.
I do tu-re bae-non ni hi-ta su-de. Sai ta-en-de-hon ma a-men!

verses: Puji hamu ma asi ni roha
ni Tuhan Jahowa di halak Kristen i.
Ai naung diontang sude jolma tu hangoluan na sora suda.
Tuhan Jahowa panggomgom di sude.
Nasa parhosa manomba Raja i,
Marloksaloksa suruanNa mamujimuji tongtong goarNa.
Hamu parbegu, unang ma, tundal be;
Tu Tuhan Jesus ro ma hamu sude;
Ai naung di tongos do hataNa; Dosa sudena nuaeng sesaonNa.
Dohot do bohal dilehon Debata
Ndang mamahurang tuk songon na tama.
Udan pe dohot las ni ari, nasa parguna do dipasari.
I pe sai puji denggan basaNa i;
Asa lam ganda hasangaponNa i,
Tongtong do hita ramotanNa, On pe tapuji denggan basaNa.

Pujionnami do tongtong goarMi di joroMon,

verses: Hupuji holong ni rohaMu, o Tuhan Jesus, Rajangki!
Tu Ho hulehon ma tondingku, ai i do pinangidomi.
Huhalupahon ma diringku, Mamingkir holong ni rohamu.
Sai dilului Ho do ahu, Au pe huhalungunhon Ho;
Ditaiti rohaMi rohangku, dibahen i hulehon do.
Dipillit Ho hian tondingku, i pe hutodo Ho, Tuhanku.
Huhilala, ingkon mar-Tuhan, ingkon mangolu au di Ho;
Ndang jumpang au be hangoluan aut unang dipatupa Ho.
Sai Ho do paradiananku, sai gok di Ho nama langkangku.
Di Ho saleleng ni lelengna, au on o Jesus, Tuhanki!
Ho ma nampuna sasudena gogongku ro di artangki!
Ai naung dilehon Ho mudarMu manggarar utang ni dosangku.
Ai nunga tung diparhatoban Sibolis dohot dosa au;
Tuani ma Ho ro, o Tuhan mamorsan uhum na tu au;
Ditaoni Ho do hamatean mambaen di ahu hangoluan.
O Jesus, uhir ma goarMu torang, bagas tu rohangkon.
Asa tarsurat di jolongku holong ni rohaMi tongtong.
Hatangku ro di parangengku ingkon dipuji do goarMu.

r: Sai di-lu-lui Ho do a-hu, Au pe hu-ha-lu-ngun-hon Ho; Di-ta-i-ti ro-ha-Mi ro-hang-ku, di-ba-hen i hu-le-hon do. Di-pil-lit Ho hi-an ton-ding-ku, i pe hu-to-do Ho, Tu-han-ku.
